title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward looked a little sped up on Thursday night

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward looked a little sped up on Thursday night
sources.description: Titans quarterback Cam Ward's first drive of the preseason covered 95 yards and ended with a Tony Pollard touchdown run, but the night wasn't a total success for the second-year starter.
